correctness.rationale: PASS. In a finite good coarse triangulation subordinate to isotropy strata, any codimension-one face lies at a local regular two-sided point or a reflection-wall one-sided point, hence appears in exactly two or one top-dimensional cofaces with signed unit incidence. The top coboundary presentation is a signed graph: each connected component contributes 0, Z, or Z/2. Thus H^5(|X|;Z) has no torsion of order >2; in particular e_5<=2. Becerra–Lupercio Proposition 8.7 gives rank 4*gcd(4,e_5)<=8 and its smooth realization. Their Proposition 9.3 mapping-torus rank-two obstruction survives a free-point connected sum with RP^4×S^1, and the rank-four bundle glues on the trivial ball, proving the mixed-isotropy nonorientable example of minimum rank 4. The proof does NOT settle whether B=4 or B=8. The codimension-one incidence step is conditional on the source's good smooth-orbifold triangulation, not a statement about arbitrary orbispaces.
